betTicket.title: Bet Ticket
betTicket.payoutNotice: The estimated payout can change until betting closes — it depends on how much everyone else stakes. Your final winnings are confirmed once the result is settled.
betTicket.disputeTitle: See a problem with this result?
betTicket.disputeHint: The Boardman has submitted a result. If you think it's wrong, report it now — once an Admin reviews it, no automatic payout happens until they decide.

disputeStatus.OPEN: Dispute raised. Payouts are frozen until a Platform Admin reviews it.
disputeStatus.UNDER_REVIEW: A Platform Admin is reviewing this dispute. Payouts stay frozen until they decide.
disputeStatus.RESOLVED_CONFIRMED: An Admin reviewed this dispute and confirmed the result — payouts have been processed.
disputeStatus.RESOLVED_CANCELLED: An Admin reviewed this dispute and cancelled the competition — your stake was refunded.

betTicket.shareHint: Anyone with the link can see what was bet and how it ended — never who placed it.
